Restaurant Owner Ke Liye — Proposal Note

Website Business Ke Liye Kyun Zaroori Hai?

Assalamualaikum Karachi Walay team! Ye demo website hum ne khaas aap ke liye banayi hai — aap ka asal menu, teeno branches, timings aur WhatsApp number ke saath. Zara sochiye, is ke faide kya hain:

  • Google par customers aap ko dhoond rahe hain: Aap ke ~855 reviews hain, lekin website koi nahi — customer menu dekhne aata hai aur competitor ke paas chala jata hai. Website hogi to customer seedha aap ke paas rukega.
  • Orders seedha WhatsApp par, bina commission: Foodpanda waghera har order par commission kaat-te hain. Is website par har item ke saath “Order on WhatsApp” button hai — order seedha aap ke number par, commission zero.
  • Menu hamesha updated, printing ka kharcha khatam: Rate ya item badalna ho to ek message par update — dobara menu print karne ki zaroorat nahi.
  • Teeno branches ek hi jagah: Shahab Pura, Citi Housing aur Cantt — customer ko har branch ka address, timing aur number ek page par mil jata hai.
  • Trust banta hai: Apni website wala restaurant bara aur professional lagta hai — shaadi/bulk orders aur family customers pehle website dekhte hain.
  • 24 ghantay khuli dukaan: Restaurant 2 AM band ho jata hai, website nahi soti — customer raat ko menu dekh kar agle din ka order plan kar leta hai.

Packages (Ghouri Web Studio): Basic Website Rs 15,000 · Product/Menu Showcase Rs 30,000 · 3D Interactive Rs 60,000 · Care plan Rs 3,000/month (updates + support). Ye demo pasand aaye to yehi design aap ke asal photos aur mukammal rates ke saath live kar di jayegi.

Demo Pasand Aaya? Baat Karein

Demo by Ghouri Web Studio — hum har business ke liye websites banate hain: restaurant, dukaan, exporter, clinic, sab ke liye.
